author: Ptack04
body: Now, I have been spleefed and trolled many time on the avicus server. The mods have seen it and pointed it out, but they never dish out punishments. They'll say something but the "troller" keeps at it. Could the mods start kicking more people for team spleen and briefing. Please do it would help us all. Thank you.

replies.author: Camemes
replies.body:
Team griefing and trolling are immediate kicks depending on the severity. 
If staff are failing to punish players, email support@avicus.net with proof.
I personally kick team griefers and trollers/spleefers immediately.
